messages.subject: MapReduce example
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to run simple map reduce example in rhipe, I have unique key and value associated with that key.
For e.g,
I send 92 key,value set to map function. I need to get mean/average value out from map function.

Since my key are unique, map function is doing group by key I guess, that is why I am getting 92 output from map function.

Do you have any idea how can I define own map function to sum all values and get one output.


In Rhipe, can we define our own mapper java class?

Here is simple map function, I am trying to implement on R.

map <- rhmap({
    v <- rawToChar(serialize(map.values,NULL,ascii=TRUE))
    k <- map.keys
     rhcollect(k,mean(v))
     })

since keys is unique, I am getting different output for different keys.

Regards
Bikash

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] MapReduce example
parts:
I think you've misunderstood rhmap. What you should do is

map = expression({
     mapply(function(k,r) {
       rhcollect(k,  c(1,r))  
    }, map.keys, map.values)
})

reduce = rhoptions()$templates$colsummer
Then for every k, you will get a) total number of obs, and b) sum of obs

Use that.

I have no idea why you're computing the mean of rawToChar(serialize(....))
